hints: Build an adjacency list of (neighbour, cost) pairs. Remember the roads are one-way.
Use a min-heap of (distance, node). Pop the closest, and for each road out of it check whether it gives a shorter distance.
Skip a popped entry if its distance is larger than the best one already recorded for that node.
